entries.summary: I modernize BCP backend services with Quarkus and cloud-native architecture.
highlights: Migrated applications from RxJava to Quarkus, moving the stack to a cloud-native architecture.
Refactored Java services around Quarkus principles: native compilation, fast startup and a low memory footprint.
Contributed to the Azure Functions initiative, enabling event-driven serverless processes across the bank's ecosystem.

entries.summary: Backend for the HR applications of a leading Peruvian retail group.
highlights: Raised system performance by 30–40%, including stored procedure optimization.
Led the migration from a monolith to CQRS for better scalability and separation of concerns.
Set up observability with Grafana, Loki, Promtail and Prometheus, and built Spring Batch jobs for high-volume data.

entries.summary: Microservices and APIs for Cencosud: API security and authentication, architecture templates, internal training and a log dashboard.
highlights: Led a three-person microservices project and moved its build from Maven to Gradle.
Drove internal system improvements that made our projects 20% more efficient.
Migrated data from JSON to SQL Server tables, improving data accessibility by 30%.

entries.summary: Usable, fast web applications with JavaScript at an IT consultancy.
highlights: Built usable, fast web applications with JavaScript, HTML and CSS for the consultancy's clients.
